title: Ginny Doll - Easter Bunny Vintage 1984 Vogue Dolls Poseable Vinyl 8" NIB
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The Ginny Doll from 1984 by Vogue Dolls is a vintage poseable vinyl doll standing at 8 inches tall. This 8" fashion doll is designed as a girl doll and is a perfect addition to any doll collection or for those who appreciate nostalgic toys from the past. The set includes the doll itself, made from high-quality vinyl material, making it a timeless piece for collectors and fans of classic dolls.
